<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The user confirmed that the first punch after 12:00 PM indicates a first half-day leave.

A new Iceberg table will share the same grain. It will contain Department, AttendanceStatus, PunchCount, and LeaveStatus columns. LeaveStatus will be derived from leave data by checking working_days_hours. A value of 0.5 indicates a half-day leave. Values of 1 or more indicate a full leave. No leave means present. The working_days_hours and duration_unit fields must be passed through the leave staging and expansion layers.

Half-day leaves typically span a single day. A rule is needed if a full leave and a half-day leave occur on the same date. AttendanceStatus will combine leave status with punch timing. First half leave applies when the first punch occurs after 12:00 PM. Second half leave applies when the last punch is at or before 1:00 PM. Full leave maps to IsLeave. All other cases map to present.

If both half-day punch conditions are met, the first half leave takes priority. A rare edge case is being considered where the first punch falls after noon but the last punch is still before 1:00 PM.

The tie-breaker for overlapping half-day conditions is now defined. If the first punch is after noon and the last punch is at or before 1:00 PM, the record is classified as a first half leave. Otherwise it is a second half leave.

LeaveStatus will be purely derived from leave data. AttendanceStatus will use leave data for full leaves and half-day leaves. It will use punch times to distinguish first half from second half leaves.

Punch patterns alone will not classify a record as half-day leave. Only leave data with 0.5 working days will trigger a half-day status. Full leave remains tied to leave data with 1 or more days. Present is the default when neither condition is met.

The user's phrasing suggests punch times may independently flag a half-day leave. The revised logic combines leave data with punch timing. LeaveStatus will remain purely from leave data. AttendanceStatus will apply a first half leave when LeaveStatus is HalfDay and the first punch is null or after noon.

Punch-only half-day classification will be included as a fallback when leave data lacks a 0.5 day. This risks noise because employees may not punch on a half-day leave. The plan will note this trade-off.

The final classification hierarchy is now set. Full leave days take precedence over half-day leave days. If no leave covers the date, the first punch after noon marks a first half leave. Otherwise the last punch at or before 1:00 PM marks a second half leave. Any remaining punch records are treated as present. Employees without punches on leave days will appear as leave, since the spine only includes office, onsite, and leave rows.

Punch counts will be tallied from office events and onsite clock-ins and clock-outs. The implementation will extend `stg_leave_data` to preserve `working_days_hours` and `duration_unit`. A new intermediate layer may carry `punch_count`, leave duration, and leave status instead of bloating `int_attendance_day`.

The new table will be named `dataproducts.employee.employee_attendance_status`. It will reuse the existing employee, business email, and date grain. Columns include Department, AttendanceStatus, PunchCount, and LeaveStatus. First and last punch times may be added for debugging.

The table will stay limited to the requested columns plus identity and date. Leave durations must be parsed as decimals, and only day units should count toward half-day leaves. The staging layer currently drops duration, so those columns need to be preserved. A half-day leave typically spans a single calendar date.

Expanding multi-day leave ranges into individual calendar days is problematic because working_days_hours represents the total leave duration rather than a per-day allocation. The simplest rule is to treat a leave as a half-day only when the from_date and to_date fall on the same day and the working_days_hours equals 0.5. When the leave spans multiple days, the integer working_days_hours should match the number of weekdays in the range to indicate a full leave on each day.

A 0.5 working_days_hours value will be applied to every calendar day in the leave range, even though the total usually spans a single day. The punch count will be derived by counting attendance events grouped by employee and date inside the intermediate table.

Punch counts will be summed across office and onsite sources. The count must propagate through the office, onsite, and merged models. Tests will verify grain, status values, and non-negative punch counts. The Airflow pipeline needs a new dbt test selection. The new table will share the existing July 2026 date filter. Null last punch handling will mirror the existing report logic.

Punch-only half-day classification is being restricted to cases where LeaveStatus is already HalfDay. This prevents morning-only punches from being mislabeled as second half leaves when no leave data exists. The existing report logic will be followed.

AttendanceStatus will derive its 1st and 2nd half leave subtypes directly from punch timing. Early leavers risk being misclassified as second half leaves. The plan now defines LeaveStatus as Present, IsLeave, or HalfDay, then maps AttendanceStatus from that base.

If a leave day has no punches, the status will be HalfDay without a subtype. The department column already exists in the intermediate table. I will check the department model and project configuration for naming conventions.
</details></think>

Pass through `working_days_hours` and `duration_unit` (already in `raw.employee.leave_data`).\n\nHalf day when duration unit is days (or blank) and `working_days_hours` parses to **0.5**. Beginning implementation of the daily attendance status table.

Mapping out six specific changes: adding working_days_hours and duration_unit to the leave staging model, counting punches in the daily attendance staging model, adding punch_count and is_half_day_leave to the intermediate day model, creating the semantic model, updating YAML files, and running tests and dbt commands. Half-day leaves will be detected by parsing working_days_hours to 0.5 when the duration unit indicates days.

Finalized the half-day leave logic: it triggers when the duration unit indicates days and working_days_hours parses to exactly 0.5. The leave_by_person model will aggregate this into a boolean flag. For punch counts, the staging model will add a raw office_punch_count column, and the office_daily model will sum these values by employee and date.

Office punch counts will be summed by person across multiple employee codes. Onsite punch counts will combine first and last punch indicators, then total in the onsite paired model. Merged attendance counts will coalesce office and onsite values. The semantic model will derive AttendanceStatus directly from the intermediate day model fields. The half-day default rule was simplified to trigger when the first punch occurs after noon.

Defined the exact punch-time thresholds for the half-day leave logic. First-punch-after-noon maps to "HalfDay - 1st half leave". Last-punch-at-or-before-13:00 maps to "HalfDay - 2nd half leave". Both cutoffs map to "HalfDay - 1st half leave". Neither cutoff maps to "default 1st half". Drafting the SQL CASE expression to handle these conditions.

Clarified the exact time thresholds for the half-day leave logic. A first punch at exactly 12:00:00 does not count as after noon, so the status falls back to the last-punch check. If the last punch is at 18:00:00, neither cutoff applies and the default 1st half leave status is assigned. Now beginning to define the LeaveStatus logic.

Finalized the LeaveStatus logic as a three-way CASE expression: 'HalfDay' for half-day leaves, 'IsLeave' for regular leaves, and 'Present' otherwise. Decided to represent is_half_day_leave as a boolean true/false value rather than Yes/No to match the existing is_leave field format.

Decided to compute is_half_day_leave at the staging level rather than per expanded day. The staging model will parse working_days_hours into a numeric value and flag half-day leaves when the duration unit indicates days and the parsed value equals 0.5. Now proceeding to implement all file changes.

_**Agent (grok-4.6)**_

A second Iceberg table is in place: **`dataproducts.employee.employee_attendance_status`**. `employee_attendance_report` is unchanged.

**Grain:** one row per employee + date (same as the existing report, July 2026). Identity columns (`EmployeeID`, `EmployeeName`, `BusinessEmail`, `Date`) line up so the two tables can be joined.

**New columns**
- **Department** — HR, else iClock
- **PunchCount** — iClock events plus onsite clock-in/out (0 on leave-only days)
- **LeaveStatus** — `Present` / `IsLeave` / `HalfDay` from leave duration (0.5 days = half day)
- **AttendanceStatus** — `Present` / `Leave` / `HalfDay - 1st half leave` / `HalfDay - 2nd half leave`

Half-day split uses punches only when leave duration is 0.5: first punch after 12:00 noon → 1st half; last punch at or before 13:00 → 2nd half; otherwise 1st half.

**Files**
- Staging: duration on `stg_leave_data`; `office_punch_count` on `stg_daily_attendance`
- Intermediate: `punch_count` and `is_half_day_leave` on `int_attendance_day`
- Semantic: `employee_attendance_status.sql` plus yml, grain test, and dbt test select

dbt was not run against Trino from this environment. After deploy, run `dbt run --select path:models/semantic` and the updated test select to materialize and validate the table.

Adding total hours in office and punch status columns. Single punches will appear in the first punch column. A 1 PM cutoff will flag half-day punches. Attendance and leave statuses will merge for unauthorized half-day leaves.

Reviewing existing status logic. The merged column will combine leave data with inferred half-day punches. Full leaves will remain as Leave or IsLeave.

Mapping the merged status values. Present and authorized leave remain unchanged. Half-day leaves will be labeled as 1st half or 2nd half based on the corresponding punch time. Unauthorized half-day leaves will carry the same labels when inferred from punches without leave data.

Deciding whether to drop the LeaveStatus column entirely or keep it and fold its meaning into AttendanceStatus.

Settled on removing the LeaveStatus column entirely. All attendance and leave information will live in a single merged column. The final status values are Present, Leave, HalfDay - 1st half leave, HalfDay - 2nd half leave, and Unauthorized half-day leave.

Distinguishing unauthorized half-day leaves by half. The first half will be labeled "Unauthorized half-day leave - 1st half" and the second half "Unauthorized half-day leave - 2nd half".

Realized the 1 PM half-day rules are mutually exclusive. A single punch cannot be both after 1 PM and before 1 PM. The first half applies to punches after 1 PM. The second half applies to punches before 1 PM.

Clarified the half-day cutoffs. First punch strictly after 1 PM marks the morning half. Last punch strictly before 1 PM marks the afternoon half. An exact 1 PM punch does not qualify for either half. A single punch will be kept in the first punch column only, with the last punch column left empty and the punch status marked as incomplete.

Single punches will be marked as punch incomplete rather than unauthorized half-day leaves. A lone punch after 1 PM counts as both an incomplete punch and an unauthorized first half. A lone punch before 1 PM is only an incomplete punch, since it could also be an unauthorized second half.

The single punch will be treated as the first punch. A lone punch before 1 PM therefore cannot be flagged as a second half leave because the last punch column remains empty. That lone punch may instead signal an early departure or a missed out punch.

Office hours will be calculated as the duration between the first and last punch, returning NULL when only one punch exists. The punch count stays at one even after collapsing a single punch to the first column. A lone punch before 1 PM will be marked as incomplete, while two or more punches will be marked as complete.

PunchStatus will use three explicit values: "Punch incomplete" for one punch, "Punch complete" for two or more, and "No punch" when no punches exist. TotalHoursInOffice will follow the same formula as the employee attendance report, returning NULL whenever the last punch is missing.

Updating the AttendanceStatus test cases and removing the LeaveStatus column. The 1 PM half-day cutoff and punch collapsing logic are confined to the semantic model and output. The merged status implementation will use a CASE expression, mapping authorized full leaves to "Leave" and first-half authorized leaves to "HalfDay - 1st half leave".

The merged status CASE expression now includes the unauthorized half-day branch. A lone punch after 1 PM will be labeled "Unauthorized half-day leave - 1st half". A lone punch before 1 PM will be labeled "Unauthorized half-day leave - 2nd half". The default unauthorized half-day label is "Unauthorized half-day leave".

Finalized the unauthorized half-day labels as "Unauthorized half-day leave (1st half)" and "(2nd half)". Confirmed the 1 PM cutoff logic handles edge cases correctly: a lone punch after 1 PM flags the first half, and two punches both after 1 PM still flag the first half.

Revised the half-day inference rules. A lone punch will not be treated as a second half unauthorized leave, since that would wrongly flag every morning single punch. The second half unauthorized label will apply only when a last punch exists after collapsing a single punch into the first column. The first half unauthorized label will apply when the first punch occurs after 1 PM, even for a single punch.
